activity.notes: ATLAS uses c.1400–c.1450 as a deliberately broad approximate floruit window, not as exact life dates. Oxford's current biographical reconstruction places Kabir probably in the first half of the fifteenth century (c.1398–1448) in or around Banaras. Banaras lay under the Sharqi/Jaunpur political sphere for much of this period, so the Jaunpur Sultanate association is historical context rather than a claim that Kabir held office or served the state.

sources.title: Kabir/Kabir Panth — Oxford Bibliographies in Hinduism
sources.citation_text: Oxford Bibliographies states that, insofar as Kabir can be reconstructed historically, he probably lived in the first half of the fifteenth century, c.1398–1448, in or around Banaras.

sources.title: History — District Jaunpur, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sources.citation_text: The Government of Uttar Pradesh district history documents the independent Sharqi political order centered on Jaunpur during the relevant fifteenth-century period; ATLAS uses it as polity-identity support.
